facts.value: Helpful tips for searching and applying for internships in the country are available on the pages of the e-Career Service.
Job placement and job offers are available below on the Career Service's pages.
For information and advice on internships abroad, contact the staff at the International Office and the student initiative AIESEC.
The Career Service can help with job placements for student assistant positions, temporary project placements, internships, or entry-level positions.
Job offers of all kinds can be found at the job boards of the Career Service or the Student Union Frankfurt am Main.
For legal questions about working during your studies, you can get information and advice from the Student Union Frankfurt am Main.
Current job offers for student assistants and tutors can be found here.
Information regarding a PhD in the Department of Economics can be found here.
Current PhD positions at Goethe University can be found here.
Current PhD positions in German-speaking areas can be found on the pages of the Career Service.
